uncovered_shapes.sentence: Getting better sleep might be as simple as moving a little more every day according to the same study.

claims.claim: A landmark survey counted roughly 180,000 giant tortoises on the Seychelles atoll of Aldabra.
claims.supporting_quote: A landmark survey of the world’s largest free-roaming giant tortoise population has revealed the once-endangered species is now thriving. The latest count of tortoises on the Seychelles atoll of Aldabra revealed that there are approximately 180,000 living on the islands.

claims.source_title: Just 10 minutes of daily exercise could unlock deeper sleep
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers at The University of Texas at Austin found that people who exercised more frequently experienced more deep, restorative sleep... Surprisingly, just 10 minutes of moderate to vigorous exercise per day was associated with measurable benefits.

claims.claim: A retired doctor in Australia has planted thousands of native trees and restored 120 hectares of a 200-hectare property over multiple years.
